function.name: ws_list_tree
function.description: List files and directories under the coding scope root (depth-limited). Paths are relative to the scope root. Only allowed paths are returned.

path.description: Relative path under the scope root (default ".")

function.name: ws_search
function.description: Search file contents under the coding scope with a regex. Only allowed files are searched. Returns matching paths with line snippets.

path.description: Optional relative subdirectory to search under (default ".")

function.name: ws_read
function.description: Read a text file under the coding scope. Paths are relative to the scope root. Optional line range (1-based, inclusive).

function.name: ws_edit
function.description: Replace an exact unique substring in a file under the coding scope. Fails if old_string is missing or appears more than once. Requires user approval.

old_string.description: Exact text to find (must appear exactly once)

function.name: ws_write
function.description: Create or overwrite a file under the coding scope. Requires user approval.

function.name: ws_delete
function.description: Delete a file under the coding scope. Requires user approval.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a shell command with the coding scope root as cwd. Allowlisted read/verify commands auto-run; others require user approval. Prefer git_status/git_diff for git reads.

function.name: git_status
function.description: Show git status for the coding scope root (read-only).

function.name: git_diff
function.description: Show git diff for the coding scope root (read-only). Optional path relative to root.

path.description: Optional relative path to limit the diff

function.name: git_checkout_branch
function.description: Create and/or switch to a git branch under the coding scope. Requires user approval. Prefer this before mutating files when on main/master.

branch.description: Branch name to create or switch to

create.description: If true, create the branch (-b). Default true when the branch does not exist.
